name: Zero Order Integration (Rectangle Rule)
aliases: Riemann Sum Approximation for Volume Rendering
Quadrature Approximation of Volume Rendering Integral
definition: A numerical integration technique for volume rendering that approximates the scalar signal as constant within each ray segment, using the rectangle rule on a Riemann sum.
summary: Zero Order Integration approximates volume rendering by assuming constant density and color within discrete ray segments, distinguishing itself by requiring only one sample per segment and avoiding pre-integration tables.
